steps.title: Initialize Android Project Structure & Configuration
steps.description: Set up the basic Android project files, including app-meta.json, AndroidManifest.xml, and app/build.gradle. Ensure correct version codes and names are applied, and remove any disallowed external dependencies, specifically 'org.nanohttpd:nanohttpd'.

steps.title: Define Note Data Model
steps.description: Create the 'Note' Java class to represent individual notes with properties for ID, title, content, and category.

steps.title: Implement Note Data Storage Logic
steps.description: Develop the 'NoteStorage' Java class for managing notes and categories using SharedPreferences. This includes correcting the JSON string literal for default categories by escaping internal double quotes to prevent compilation errors.

steps.title: Design Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the layout for 'MainActivity', including a ListView for notes, an EditText for search, a Spinner for category filtering, and buttons for adding new notes and managing categories.

steps.title: Develop Main Activity Functionality
steps.description: Implement the Java code for 'MainActivity' to load, display, filter, search, and manage notes, including handling user interactions and navigation to other activities.

steps.title: Create Note List Item Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for a single note item to be displayed in the 'notesListView' of 'MainActivity', showing the note's title and a content preview.

steps.title: Design Note Detail Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the layout for 'NoteDetailActivity', providing input fields for note title, content, a spinner for category selection, and buttons to save or delete a note.

steps.title: Implement Note Detail Activity Logic
steps.description: Develop the Java code for 'NoteDetailActivity' to handle creating new notes, editing existing notes, saving changes, and confirming note deletion.

steps.title: Design Category Management Activity Layout
steps.description: Create the layout for 'CategoryManageActivity', including an EditText and Button to add new categories, and a ListView to display existing categories with deletion capability.

steps.title: Create Category List Item Layout
steps.description: Design the layout for a single category item to be displayed in the 'categoriesListView' of 'CategoryManageActivity', showing the category name.

steps.title: Implement Category Management Activity Logic
steps.description: Develop the Java code for 'CategoryManageActivity' to enable users to add and delete categories, ensuring 'All' and 'Uncategorized' default categories are handled correctly.

steps.title: Building Notes Categorized
steps.description: Compile and assemble the 'Notes Categorized' application into a debug APK.
